purpose: Represent complete PDDR records with tokenizer-aware chunks while holding model, gold, query text, ranking target, and Top-k fixed.

comparison_boundary.primary_question: Does complete-record chunking change required-context recall at the same Top-2 budget relative to the frozen first-512-token embedding baseline?

interpretation_limits: Max-chunk aggregation may favor longer documents because they produce more chunks; this condition measures that exact frozen rule.
A result difference is attributable to the representation/aggregation condition as a whole, not to chunking alone in isolation.
